placements.title: An instrument counts as calibrated only once it is checked against reference evidence
placements.frame: What setting is the instrument held to, and what reference evidence was it verified against before the observatory treats it as calibrated?
placements.why: The graph is empty, so there is no leaf to reuse. The position ties the Kestrelwood setting (88.4 MHz) to verification against the June reference plates. The setting and the plates are position-grain evidence. The theme future envelopes will keep feeding is that instrument calibration is claimed together with the reference evidence that verifies it. That theme passes the grain test.
